settings.label: What exactly is the club?
settings.text: A free programme for account holders. There are no points: you get a first-order gift, a yearly birthday gift, early access and event invitations.

settings.label: How do I sign up?
settings.text: Create an account on the sign-in page, or add your email at checkout and choose to join.

settings.label: Where is my keychain code?
settings.text: It is emailed after you register. Paste it at checkout on your next order, and check spam if it has not appeared in an hour.

settings.label: I already have an account. Am I a member?
settings.text: Yes. Sign in once and the club perks attach themselves to your existing account.

settings.label: I never got my birthday gift.
settings.text: Add your birthday to the account page, then write to us and we will check it manually.

settings.label: Who can join?
settings.text: Anyone aged 18 or over who lives in the United States. You can leave at any time by emailing support.

settings.heading: Be first to know about the next drop
settings.message: New scents, balm flavours and member-only sale days, no more than one note a week.
